description: This Java class 'CompatUtils' provides utility methods for compatibility across different Android API levels, including loading native libraries with fallback mechanisms, setting properties on UI components, and object comparison.

classes.name: CompatUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for compatibility handling across different Android API levels, including native library loading, drawable unbinding, popup window adjustments, object equality, and PendingIntent flag management.

methods.name: setPopupUnattachedToDecor
methods.description: Sets the attachedInDecor property of a PopupWindow to false if the Android version is Lollipop MR1 or higher.

methods.name: unbindDrawable
methods.description: Unbinds a Drawable by setting its callback to null.

methods.name: loadNativeLibrary
methods.description: Attempts to load a native library using ReLinker, with fallback to System.loadLibrary if necessary, and logs errors if loading fails.

methods.name: fallbackLoading
methods.description: Performs fallback loading of a native library using System.loadLibrary, with error logging and exception throwing if loading fails.

methods.name: objectEquals
methods.description: Provides a null-safe equality check between two objects, similar to Objects.equals, for API levels below 19.

methods.name: appendImmutableFlag
methods.description: Adds the FLAG_IMMUTABLE flag to PendingIntent flags if the Android version is Marshmallow or higher.
